summary: Marex Group Limited furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release, reporting record results rather than a transactional event. Year-to-date revenue rose 47% to $2,131.3m and Adjusted Profit Before Tax 63% to $494.7m; Q3 revenue reached $743.2m with Adjusted PBT of $176.1m and Adjusted Basic EPS of $1.75. Management cited acquisition execution, including Winterflood, Levmet, Webb Traders and the agreed Bright Point purchase, plus clearing and FX gains. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated; the filing is a routine earnings disclosure.
